name: ProjectMind for Cursor IDE & Agent CLI
description: Project intelligence, Cursor MCP server, v1 lifecycle hooks, and projectmind.mdc rule integration.

capabilities.restartInstructions: Cursor watches `.cursor/hooks.json` and `.cursor/mcp.json` automatically; ensure workspace is trusted.
documentedLimitations: Project hooks require the workspace to be marked Trusted in Cursor.

installationInstructions: Run `projectmind plugin install cursor` in your project root.
upgradeInstructions: Run `projectmind plugin update cursor` to refresh configs, skills, and hooks.
removalInstructions: Run `projectmind plugin uninstall cursor` to cleanly remove integration while preserving project knowledge.
